en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a European town square with cobblestone streets, large leafy trees, a church tower on the left, historic multi‑story buildings, and a prominent ornate war memorial monument with a statue on the right. Printed caption text in red identifies the scene as Wilhelmsplatz with a war memorial in Naumburg. The printer's credit appears in small type at the bottom left.
